menu.dietaryNotes: Rice-based dishes (jambalaya, étouffée base, red beans & rice) are gluten-free, but our gumbo roux contains wheat and all fried items share one fryer, so we can't guarantee zero cross-contact for celiac guests. Red Beans & Rice is vegan by default. Most dishes can be made mild on request — our default spice is medium.

catering.summary: Full-service catering for events of 20 to 250 guests, drop-off or staffed.
catering.pricing: Drop-off packages from $28/person (po'boy spread) to $45/person (boil buffet with sides and beignets). Staffed events add $150 per server. Custom menus available.
catering.leadTime: At least 72 hours notice; one week preferred for events over 75 guests.
catering.deliveryArea: Free delivery within 15 miles of the restaurant; beyond that $2/mile.
catering.deposit: 50% deposit to confirm the date, refundable up to 7 days before the event.
catering.privateRoom: Our private back room (The Parlor) seats up to 24 for on-site private events with a $500 food & beverage minimum.

reservations.policy: Parties of 6 or fewer are walk-in only — the wait is rarely more than 20 minutes except Friday and Saturday evenings. Parties of 7 or more should call ahead at least a day in advance so we can set a table or the private room. We don't take reservations through third-party apps.
reservations.largeParty: For parties of 10+ we offer a family-style set menu at $35/person that makes big tables much smoother.

parking.details: Free 12-space lot behind the building (enter from SE 36th). Metered street parking on Division is free after 7 PM and on Sundays. Two EV chargers in the lot, and bike racks out front.

faqs.q: Do you have a kids menu?
faqs.a: Yes — chicken tenders, mac & cheese, or a mini shrimp po'boy, each $8 with a drink.
Dogs are welcome on the covered patio, and we'll bring water bowls.
Our default is a friendly medium. Almost anything can be made mild, and we keep house-made hot sauces on every table for heat-seekers.
Yes, at the register in any amount, or digital gift cards through our website.

faqs.q: Is there a wait on weekends?
faqs.a: Friday and Saturday after 6 PM you should expect 30–45 minutes. Put your name in and grab a Hurricane at the bar.

faqs.q: Do you do takeout or delivery?
faqs.a: Takeout yes — order by phone. Delivery is through the usual apps, though boils travel best picked up hot.
Live Louisiana crawfish typically runs February through June. Follow our socials — we announce each week's boil availability on Thursdays.
